_comment: procedural map tuning for the current tiled room path

map._comment: values here are read into mapgenerationconfig and applied every run build and reset
map._comment_tile_size: the tiled prefab currently drives the real room tile size
map._comment_room_size: old random-room size values are still here as reference while the tiled room prefab is repeated
map._comment_room_buffer: keep at least one tile between repeated rooms so doorways and halls have space to meet
map._comment_max_hallway: caps how far a newly placed room can be from existing rooms so hallways stay shorter
map._comment_obstacles_unused: old obstacle tuning is not used by the current tiled room path

colors._comment: flat colors for now; replace with tiles later
